name: thear
description: Over-confident, overpowering tank. Swings a cleaver as tall as he is one-handed out of contempt; when he finally grips it with both hands, mountains split. His blade is two swords locked together.
note: Exported by Rig Forge. Frames face right; the image centre (origin_px) is the figure's position in-game; anchors are image px per frame. FX live in <name>.fxkit.json, written by the FX Studio into this folder.
